title: Method of preparation, visualization and ultrastructural analysis of a formulation of probiotic Bacillus subtilis KATMIRA1933 produced by solid-phase fermentation
author: Fedorenko, Fedorenko, et al.

steps.title: Prepare inoculated soybean substrate
steps.instruction: Wash 1 kg dry Don‑21 soybeans, soak overnight in two volumes of tap water, drain, autoclave 15 min at 121 °C, cool to 60 °C, add 10 mL overnight culture of B. subtilis KATMIRA1933 (10⁸ CFU/mL) in LB medium and mix thoroughly, spread beans 3–5 cm thick in a sterile tray with a non‑hermetic lid, incubate 24 h at 42 °C.

substeps.instruction: Soak overnight in two volumes of tap water
Drain water and autoclave beans for 15 min at 121 °C
Add 10 mL overnight B. subtilis KATMIRA1933 culture (10⁸ CFU/mL) in LB medium; mix thoroughly
Place beans in sterile tray, layer 3–5 cm, cover with non‑hermetic lid

steps.title: Grind, dry and mill product
steps.instruction: Grind the inoculated beans (≈50 % moisture, biofilm 3 × 10¹¹ CFU/g) with a Kenwood 700 MG meat grinder, spread the mass in open trays 1–2 cm thick, incubate 48–72 h at 45 °C in a Binder VD720 ventilated chamber until moisture reaches 5 %, then mill the dried granules in a Braun KMM 30 coffee grinder under aseptic conditions.

substeps.instruction: Grind beans using Kenwood 700 MG meat grinder
Spread resulting mass in open trays, layer 1–2 cm
Incubate 48–72 h at 45 °C in ventilated chamber (VD720) until moisture is 5 %
Mill dried granules in Braun KMM 30 coffee grinder aseptically
